INSERT INTO host_asset_inventory (tenant_id, host_id, mac_address, task_id, source, category, sub_category, vendor, product, product_version, protocol, port, rule_id, confidence, first_seen, last_seen, raw_banner, deleted) VALUES
(COALESCE(#{item.tenantId}, 0), #{item.hostId}, #{item.macAddress}, #{item.taskId}, #{item.source}, #{item.category}, #{item.subCategory}, #{item.vendor}, #{item.productName}, #{item.productVersion}, COALESCE(#{item.protocol}, 'tcp'), #{item.port}, #{item.ruleId}, #{item.confidence}, #{item.firstSeen}, #{item.lastSeen}, #{item.bannerRaw}, COALESCE(#{item.deleted}, 0))
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT hai.host_id, hai.task_id FROM host_asset_inventory hai JOIN hosts h ON h.id = hai.host_id WHERE hai.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (hai.deleted = 0 OR hai.deleted IS NULL)
AND ( h.hostname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR h.mac_address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR hai.task_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(hai.port AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR hai.product LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR hai.category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR hai.sub_category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND h.mac_address = #{macAddress}
GROUP BY hai.host_id, hai.task_id ) t

SELECT MAX(hai.id) AS id, hai.tenant_id, hai.host_id, MAX(hai.mac_address) AS mac_address, hai.task_id, MAX(hai.source) AS source, MAX(hai.category) AS category, MAX(hai.sub_category) AS sub_category, MAX(hai.vendor) AS vendor, NULL AS port, NULL AS product_version, MAX(hai.protocol) AS protocol, MAX(hai.product) AS product_name, MAX(hai.category) AS product_type, MAX(hai.confidence) AS confidence, NULL AS rule_id, NULL AS banner_raw, MAX(hai.deleted) AS deleted, MIN(hai.first_seen) AS first_seen, MAX(hai.last_seen) AS last_seen, MIN(hai.created_at) AS created_at, MAX(hai.updated_at) AS updated_at FROM host_asset_inventory hai WHERE hai.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND hai.id = #{id} AND (hai.deleted = 0 OR hai.deleted IS NULL) GROUP BY hai.tenant_id, hai.host_id, hai.task_id
